# Channel Banners

Channel banners: design a YouTube channel banner with your channel name and tagline at 2560 x 1440, the text kept in the safe area that shows on phones, desktops and TVs.

## What it does
Give the channel name, the tagline and the theme. Claude tells you the price and designs the banner in the full channel art size.

**How the files are made:** each channel banner is generated by an image model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

The lettering is drawn by the model, so check it in the result.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install channel-banners@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Channel Banners talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/youtube-banner/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each channel banner uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The channel banners show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_channel_banner_models` | Models for channel banners with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_channel_banner_cost` | Exact price of one channel banner before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_channel_banner` | Starts one channel banner in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_channel_banner` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Make a YouTube banner for my cooking channel Spice Lab"
- "Design a gaming channel banner for PixelRush with a neon look"
- "Create a minimal travel channel banner with the tagline Go Further"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the channel banner (the channel name, tagline, theme and style) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
